notes: Modified cash basis village (FY ended 9/30/2025). Governmental receipts/disbursements from the Total Governmental Funds column of the governmental funds statement (p4); the 'Taxes' line (70,348) is split using the General and Street fund statements (property tax credit 4,037 + 49 is recorded as intergovernmental/state aid per the extractor rules, although the p2/p4 statements print it under Taxes) and the 'Other' line (62,106) is split by the fund statements (p10, p13, p18, p19, p20); Intergovernmental - state 118,271 is kept as printed (it includes Street motor vehicle fee 4,734). Loan proceeds 255,001 and transfers 24,892 in/out are in their own fields. Business-type from the proprietary statement p6 (Totals column): balances are cash (modified cash basis; net position equals cash incl. restricted); Loan proceeds 82,060 are in business_type.debt_proceeds. Business-type receipts total 478,887 is not printed; computed (excludes loan proceeds); disbursements 527,775 agrees with p2 Total business-type activities. The proprietary statement prints Miscellaneous income 1,230 but p7 calls it Cash receipts from dividends; classified as investment income with review. Balance sheet: Statement of Net Position - Modified Cash Basis, Total column (p1); no liabilities printed, total_liabilities left null. Detail: the only budget schedule in the trimmed PDF is the All Funds combined budget-and-actual schedule (p9), with no per-fund budget columns and so no business-type per-fund budget lines; it is not recorded in detail to avoid double counting with the fund-level statements (budget_final is therefore null throughout). Detail instead uses the per-fund actual statements: General (p10-12, more detailed than p4), Street, Community Improvement, Cemetery, Cafe, Housing, Public Trust, Medical Center (p13-20) and Water/Sewer/Sanitation from p6. The Cafe, Community Improvement and Cemetery statements print no total expenditures line, so no expenditure detail_total is given for them; Housing and Medical Center expenditures are single unlabeled lines. General Fund loan proceeds (255,001) sit inside printed Total Revenues 486,513 so that total carries includes other financing; General transfers out and Street transfers in are printed below the expenditure totals (outside_printed_total). Community Improvement 'DONATION' 73,449 and Cafe 'Donations' 66,525 are treated as spending (they match Economic Development 139,974 on p4). Business-type fund expenditure totals use the per-fund total expenditures printed on p2 (statement of activities) because p6 prints only operating expenditure totals. Page mapping: trimmed p1-8 = report pages 5-12 (statements), p9 = report p28, p10-20 = report p30-40. Read pages 1-20 of 20
